annotations.text:
Guidelines for the frontend the framework generates — apps/admin/public/.

Colours, radii and control geometry are lifted from site/assets/styles.css. Where a value is a proposal rather than an existing one, the sheet says so.

The four authorities (agent, policy, human, evidence) are the product's own semantics, not a palette: they decide what a state looks like.

Sheets 01-03 are the system. Screens 04-05 show it doing real work.

Both screens are drawn from real code. 04 shows only fields the opportunity module actually declares, humanised the way admin-modules.js humanises them. 05 quotes standardSalesDiscountV1 from the b2b-lead-qualification starter, with the long reason strings elided at the marked ellipses.

Company and person names are invented; every identifier, threshold and state string is not.
